about: St. Andrews is a rural municipality in Manitoba’s Interlake, north of Winnipeg along the Red River—not a city and not St. Andrews, New Brunswick. Historic river lots, Lockport, and agricultural acreages share a corridor of Métis and settler heritage toward Lake Winnipeg. About 12,000 people live in St. Andrews RM.
